description: This file serves as the server entry point for a Remix-based web application, handling server-side rendering, request handling, and response streaming for both bots and browsers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main export function handling incoming requests, setting CORS headers, and delegating to bot or browser request handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot user-agents, streaming the rendered output with appropriate error handling.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser user-agents, streaming the output with error handling similar to bot requests.
